title: Creaking (HARDMODE)
description: It Makes The Creaking Extremely Powerful (he also floats in there).
body:
This Mod Will Make The Creeking Way Harder. (Things That It Does) 1. Makes It Fast 2. Makes It Very Strong. 3. Once You Get Hit You Will Catch On Fire. 4. Even If You Look At It, It Will Still Follow. (Good Thing) Mobs Can Spawn Like Pigs, Sheeps And Cows. (IMPORTANT) THIS ONLY WORKS IN THE SINGLE BIOME MODE IT HAS TO BE THE PALE GARDEN

This Is My First Ever Mod.

Floating Will Be Fixed Next Verison.
